dialogues.speaker: Saimon Katsumi
dialogues.text: Haha, it's you! Thanks for helping me get Jirou back. He certainly seems more responsible now.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Katsumi
dialogues.text: He's been talking about wanting to tend to the fields... Oh well, I suppose it's not a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Katsumi
dialogues.text: He left home only to find that it's still better here. He's been through quite a bit, though I suppose it all ended well.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Katsumi
dialogues.text: As for me, I'm getting old and I don't expect him to become something extraordinary. I'm happy as long as he's safe and leading an honest life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you for that spectacular sword.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Katsumi
dialogues.text: There's no need to thank me. It would only be fitting if someone like yourself wields the ancestral sword of the Saimon family.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Katsumi
dialogues.text: You're different from my son. I have confidence that you will find great success. Good luck, youngster.
